plan: Validate and normalize every capability before rendering, using sets for idempotent subject, legal, and redaction entries and canonical JSON for metadata conflict detection.
Create a shallow message copy, apply all redactions, and invoke the user-supplied renderer exactly once.
Assemble sorted subject and legal sections around the rendered body, then return a frozen Presentation with key-sorted metadata.

trace.source_relation: Independent stations can wrap the parcel in different sequences.
trace.target_mechanism: Capabilities are fully normalized into order-independent sets and key-indexed metadata before a single rendering pass.

trace.source_relation: Passing twice through one station has a defined physical outcome.
trace.target_mechanism: Set deduplication and canonical metadata tokens make identical repeated capabilities idempotent while detecting conflicts.

trace.source_relation: Wrapping changes presentation but not the goods inside.
trace.target_mechanism: Redaction is applied only to a shallow copy of the message, preserving the original mapping.
